review_rule: The frozen report supplies the family requirements and the original 15 resource assessments. The three explicit overrides below retain all six elements as undetermined because the reviewed public schema descriptions give examples rather than a complete field enumeration for these process elements. Undetermined is distinct from an assessed absent slot and from a count of zero. Other resource assessments retain the frozen report's source and basis.

overrides.name: Tele-KG
overrides.reviewed_scope: Tele-Knowledge Pre-training for Fault Analysis, Section II-A(3), and the Fig. 2(c) schema description, in the public arXiv full text.
overrides.basis: The description gives Event and Resource roots, a class hierarchy and example relations for product and fault knowledge. This scope does not establish a complete enumeration of the six documentary process slots; each remains undetermined.

overrides.name: KG-RAG telecom KG
overrides.reviewed_scope: Enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs) for Telecom Using Dynamic Knowledge Graphs and Explainable Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Section IV-A(1-4) and the Fig. 4 example description, in the public arXiv full text.
overrides.basis: The construction description gives slice and QoS entities, example relations, and document/paragraph provenance. These examples do not enumerate the complete process-field schema; each of the six documentary slots remains undetermined.

overrides.name: TelcoAgent 3GPP KG
overrides.reviewed_scope: TelcoAgent: A Scalable 5G Multi-KPM Forecasting With 3GPP-Grounded Explainability, Section III-A and the Fig. 2 caption, in the public arXiv full text.
overrides.basis: The description covers a specification-derived ontology for KPM definitions, physical-layer constraints and causal relationships. Its construction prose and illustration caption do not establish a complete enumeration of the six documentary process slots; each remains undetermined.

process_resource.name: Our process records
process_resource.basis: The released ontology and relational exports type all six process elements; all main-workload family requirements therefore have slots.
